data.description: Cross-cutting MCP mutation contract for safe parallel agents. Preconditions apply only to resources a mutation can overwrite, with atomic validation and no partial storage. Implemented design-document contract: Adashi issues a content-hash readToken with each complete editable document snapshot and owns the dependency and transaction bookkeeping. Agents return the token unchanged on updates and deletes rather than building explicit read/write sets. An out_of_date error includes stored false, document identity, full currentDocument, fresh readToken, and a direct instruction to merge intended edits into that document before retrying. The current document and token must describe the same snapshot; retries are checked again. Creates remain create-only with unique identities and commit-time referential validation. Unrelated document edits do not conflict through a global revision. Existing task, QA, memory, rule, and mockup resource-version contracts remain in scope until separately revised. Optional TTL intent markers are advisory scheduling signals only, and idempotency keys make safe retries deterministic.
data.name: Resource-Scoped Concurrency API
data.technology: MCP tools, Rust, optimistic concurrency, typed conflict results
